marks.label: Pick a deck
marks.sub: Music, movies, TV, books, food and more. Each deck is a pool of real things.

marks.label: Four shows, shuffled
marks.sub: Every round deals a handful of things from the deck in a random order.

marks.label: Drag to rank
marks.sub: Most mainstream on the left, most hipster on the right. Cards restyle as they move.

marks.label: Lock in
marks.sub: Your order is checked against real popularity data.

marks.label: The real ranking
marks.sub: The list reorders by IMDb ratings and Wikipedia pageviews.

marks.label: Your score
marks.sub: One point per pair in the right order: 5 of 6 here.
